shared_elements: upright rectangular slab/pillar carved in relief
horizontal register bands dividing the composition
repeated row of similar motifs along a band
zoomorphic head with prominent eye and snout/beak
justification: Both are tall upright slabs bearing relief carving organised into horizontal registers, with animal figures in profile and a row of repeated motifs across one band, but these are generic features of monumental relief. A depicts isolated, widely spaced, flat schematic animals (quadruped, bird, snake-like forms, small crouching figures) on an otherwise blank ground, whereas B is dominated by a single frontal, elaborately costumed anthropomorphic figure with dense ornament filling the whole field — an entirely different subject and compositional logic.
